UC-1440.en: Clauseo needs your Mac's permission to read its saved keys.
UC-1440.hi: Clauseo को अपनी सहेजी गई कुंजियाँ पढ़ने के लिए आपके Mac की अनुमति चाहिए।
UC-1440.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1440.note: stage E (Mac keychain prompting off): while the permissions band's keychain row reads would_ask or denied, in place of an unreadable agent key's line (first screen, composer gate, thread's expired card), Case Law's "Sign in again in Settings, under Connectors." and a tool's "Its saved key is missing…" in Skills and connectors; with the row's Allow (UD1's "Allow"), which asks for the keychain row as the band's Allow does

UC-1441.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1441.note: Skills and connectors: the short tag in place of Case Law's "Signed out" and a tool's "Key missing" while the keychain row reads would_ask or denied

UC-1442.en: macOS allowed it once only. Press Allow again and choose Always Allow.
UC-1442.hi: macOS ने इसे केवल एक बार अनुमति दी। फिर से Allow दबाएँ और Always Allow चुनें।
UC-1442.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1442.note: the keychain row (band, first screen, Settings › Privacy) and every keychain pointer when an Ask resolved with the row still would_ask: macOS's plain Allow lets one read through, only Always Allow settles it (permissions-host.ts's allowedOnce; stage E will also mark it across starts)

UC-1500.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1500.note: the permissions band, on a keychain row the lawyer refused (denied): puts the band away in this window until the next start, in memory only, never stored; the composer gate, Case Law, Settings › Plans and Connectors still point at the keychain row's Allow

U3-err-agent.key_denied.windows_linux.en: Clauseo couldn't read, save or remove the API key on this computer. Try again. If it keeps happening, show this to whoever looks after this computer.
U3-err-agent.key_denied.windows_linux.hi: Clauseo इस कंप्यूटर पर API कुंजी पढ़, सहेज या हटा नहीं सका। फिर से प्रयास करें। अगर ऐसा होता रहे, तो इसे उस व्यक्ति को दिखाएँ जो इस कंप्यूटर की देखभाल करता है।
U3-err-agent.key_denied.windows_linux.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
U3-err-agent.key_denied.windows_linux.note: agent.key_denied on Windows and Linux: the keychain (Credential Manager, the Secret Service) refused an API key's read, save or removal; no keychain row to allow there, so no Mac sentence; the Mac's line is U3-err-agent.key_denied

UC-1444.en: Removed from Clauseo. The saved sign-in stays in your Mac's keychain.
UC-1444.hi: Clauseo से हटा दिया गया। सहेजा गया साइन-इन आपके Mac के कीचेन में बना रहता है।
UC-1444.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1444.note: Settings › Connectors, over Indian Kanoon's block: Remove's outcome while ConnectorView.left_in_keychain is set (#1348): macOS refused the keychain, so Clauseo forgot Case Law here without revoking it or deleting the saved sign-in; gone once the field is false (the next Add, Add key, Sign out or Remove)
